name: SoftwareSupp

sources.title: Apply as freelancer — registration profile submission details
Identity verification via Stripe required to submit offers

conditions: Free to register an expert/freelancer profile, but activation requires their certification process (examination + technical interview) and Stripe-based identity verification
Identity verification is limited to 31 supported countries; others must invoice manually
requirements: This is a freelancer/expert marketplace (CRM, e-commerce, web, automation services) — not a product launch directory
Profile must include experience, number of realized projects, skills, LinkedIn, website and portfolio links
Certification exam and technical interview required before receiving projects
Stripe identity verification (residence country + bank account) required to bid on projects
preparation: LinkedIn profile, personal website, portfolio links
Skills/certifications in supported platforms (Pipedrive, Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, WooCommerce, Webflow, WordPress, Zapier, Klaviyo, etc.)
Bank account in one of the 31 supported countries (or be ready to invoice manually)
workflow: Register via the 'Apply as freelancer' / dedicated submission form on softwaresupp.com
Complete the profile: experience, project count, skills, LinkedIn/website/portfolio
Pass the certification examination and technical interview
Once verified and certified, profile is active and eligible for project offers
watchFor: Wrong fit for product-launch purposes — this lists *people/services*, not products; only relevant if the goal is a consultant profile backlink
Certification + interview is a real time investment, not a form-fill
Stripe verification asks for sensitive data (residence, ID scans, bank details)
Unsupported-country freelancers fall back to manual invoicing
countsAsLive: An approved expert profile visible/active in the SoftwareSupp expert network after certification and identity verification
unknowns: Whether expert profiles get a public indexable page with an outbound link
Whether listing without taking projects is allowed
